message:
Saw MDpanel is mass hiring record reviewers. 20 in one batch usually means the current process is hitting its limit.

Brighterway was built for QME and IME panels. Physicians get AI summaries, write reports, and search records all in one place. Much cheaper than headcount, and built around how your panel works.

Is this something you are actively looking at?
